DEMO-FLOOD-001.summary: The meteorological institute warns that rising river levels after six hours of heavy rain could flood low-lying homes in Bole Woreda 03 within two hours.
reasons: Source is the national meteorological institute and reports a rising river level
Residents of low-lying streets face immediate risk
A two-hour window leaves little time to act
missing_info: Expected time of peak water level

DEMO-FIRE-001.summary: A citizen reports a large warehouse fire near the main road in Bole Woreda 07, with flames at the roof and spread risk to nearby shops.
reasons: Flames at the roof and heavy smoke indicate a large fire
Neighbouring shops are at risk of catching fire
Single citizen report, not yet confirmed by a second source
missing_info: Whether fire crews are already on site

DEMO-OUTBREAK-001.summary: A health centre in Bole Woreda 11 recorded 18 cases of severe watery diarrhoea in two days from one neighbourhood. The cause is not yet confirmed.
reasons: 18 cases in two days from the same area suggests a cluster
Cause is unconfirmed, so the alert should ask for care and hygiene, not name a disease

DEMO-SET-001.summary: Three open items in Bole. The flood warning in Woreda 03 is the most urgent because water could reach homes within two hours. A reported warehouse fire in Woreda 07 comes next. A possible disease cluster in Woreda 11 needs follow-up but is less time-critical.
key_points: DEMO-FIRE-001: fire, high, Woreda 07 (single citizen report)

ranking.reason: Flood expected to reach homes within two hours, confirmed source
Active large fire near shops, reported by one citizen
Possible disease cluster, serious but slower moving

DEMO-FLOOD-001.en: ALERT: Flash flood risk in Bole Woreda 03. Water may reach low-lying homes within two hours. Move to higher ground now, avoid rivers and low-lying roads, and follow official instructions.
DEMO-FLOOD-001.am: አስቸኳይ ማስጠንቀቂያ፡ በቦሌ ወረዳ 03 ድንገተኛ የጎርፍ አደጋ ሊከሰት ይችላል። ውሃ በሁለት ሰዓት ውስጥ ዝቅተኛ ቦታ ላይ ያሉ ቤቶችን ሊደርስ ይችላል። አሁኑኑ ወደ ከፍታ ቦታ ይሂዱ፣ ወንዞችንና ዝቅተኛ መንገዶችን ያስወግዱ፣ የባለስልጣናትን መመሪያ ይከተሉ።
DEMO-FLOOD-001.sms_en: ALERT: Flood risk, Bole Woreda 03. Move to higher ground now. Avoid rivers and low roads.
DEMO-FLOOD-001.sms_am: አስቸኳይ ማስጠንቀቂያ፡ የጎርፍ አደጋ፣ ቦሌ ወረዳ 03። አሁኑኑ ወደ ከፍታ ቦታ ይሂዱ።

DEMO-FIRE-001.en: WARNING: Large fire reported at a warehouse in Bole Woreda 07. Stay away from the area, keep roads clear for fire crews, and follow official instructions.
DEMO-FIRE-001.am: ማስጠንቀቂያ፡ በቦሌ ወረዳ 07 በአንድ መጋዘን ላይ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል። ከአካባቢው ይራቁ፣ መንገዶችን ለእሳት አደጋ ሠራተኞች ክፍት ያድርጉ፣ የባለስልጣናትን መመሪያ ይከተሉ።
DEMO-FIRE-001.sms_en: WARNING: Large fire, Bole Woreda 07. Stay away and keep roads clear for fire crews.
DEMO-FIRE-001.sms_am: ማስጠንቀቂያ፡ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ፣ ቦሌ ወረዳ 07። ከአካባቢው ይራቁ።

DEMO-OUTBREAK-001.en: NOTICE: A health cluster is being investigated in Bole Woreda 11. Wash hands with soap, drink safe water, and visit the nearest health facility if you have severe diarrhoea or vomiting.
DEMO-OUTBREAK-001.am: ማሳሰቢያ፡ በቦሌ ወረዳ 11 የጤና ክስተት እየተጣራ ነው። እጅዎን በሳሙና ይታጠቡ፣ ንጹህ ውሃ ይጠጡ፣ ከባድ ተቅማጥ ወይም ትውከት ካለዎት በአቅራቢያ ወዳለ ጤና ተቋም ይሂዱ።
DEMO-OUTBREAK-001.sms_en: NOTICE: Health cluster under check, Bole Woreda 11. Wash hands, drink safe water, seek care if sick.
DEMO-OUTBREAK-001.sms_am: ማሳሰቢያ፡ የጤና ክስተት እየተጣራ ነው፣ ቦሌ ወረዳ 11። እጅዎን ይታጠቡ፣ ንጹህ ውሃ ይጠጡ።
